mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 56 degrees with clear skies under a full moon at Verona City Hall.

The City of Verona announced that a stretch of Highway M near the new Aldi location will be closed from October 5 through October 7 for road work, and motorists should continue to expect traffic shifts as part of the broader phase two construction project.
We have a busy week ahead starting with Yoga at Insight Wellness today, followed by a variety of trivia nights at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, and Paddy Mac's tomorrow and throughout the week.
On September 5, local officers investigated a series of reports involving cheese slices left on vehicle windshields, which was identified as a viral social media prank.
You can satisfy your cravings with the Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie flavor, which is today's featured selection at the Verona Culver's, with the restaurant opening today at 10 AM.
